preserveReasons.set-up_y2: Structural second-year festival map, actor, animation and control command script; preserved byte-for-byte.

corrections: Translated and reread all nineteen player-facing fall16 records from source ordinals 40 through 59 directly from English and preserved the second-year set-up script byte-for-byte.
Preserved the player, farm, dialogue, emotion and numeric markers; used neutral Bulgarian spouse address and recast two-person seating and praise to avoid assumptions about the player’s gender.

Applied locked пустинята Калико and Звезден жетон terminology, retained distinct character voices, and refined the wheel wager, fishing score and shared-bench lines for complete natural Bulgarian meaning.
